Recipe.Description: Minimal BTree-hostable AiPrimitive CONDITION. Dispatch=AiPrimitive, Primitive.Intent=Condition, Hostings=[BTreeCondition] are set up front (Dispatch/Intent are immutable post-creation, so a Condition must be authored as such from creation -- there is no in-place Action-to-Condition conversion). EventEntry -> Return(Success): the graph evaluates synchronously and returns Success/Failure only -- no Running, no latent/Wait/Delay nodes (BP1100/BP1101). Carries a Threshold (float) Parameter and a LastEvaluated (bool) WorkingState field as placeholders for a real gate expression: wire GetVariable(Threshold) into a comparison and a Branch node, then Return Success on the true branch and Failure on the false branch. Compiles to a BTreeEvaluate(...) thunk usable as a BTree condition leaf.
ConceptsTaught: AiPrimitive Condition intent: Dispatch=AiPrimitive + Primitive.Intent=Condition + Hostings=[BTreeCondition] set at creation time (immutable afterward)
Condition graphs must be synchronous: Return Success/Failure only, Running and latent/Wait/Delay nodes are compiler errors (BP1100/BP1101)
AiPrimitive Condition emits a BTreeEvaluate(...) bool thunk (wraps TickCore(...) == NodeStatus.Success) usable as a BTree condition leaf
Params/WorkingState on a Condition AiPrimitive (Threshold float Parameter, LastEvaluated bool WorkingState) size the same way as on an Action AiPrimitive
